description: This file defines a standard format for API call results, providing utility functions to create success ('ok') and error ('err') response objects used by the frontend to uniformly handle API responses.

methods.name: ok(data, meta = {})
methods.description: Builds a successful response object with data and optional metadata.

methods.name: err({ status = 0, message = "Request failed", details } = {})
methods.description: Builds an error response object with status, message, and optional details.

ctags.name: err
ctags.pattern: /^export function err({ status = 0, message = "Request failed", details } = {}) {$/
